response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong full-stack, DLang, and infrastructure exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: only brief early-career C++ experience (well under the required 8 years) and no evidence of large-scale cloud compute platform architecture, distributed systems leadership, or formal technical leadership/mentoring of cloud or DevOps teams. His skill set (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, Ember.js) and career trajectory are misaligned with the C++-heavy, cloud infrastructure leadership focus of this position.
strengths: Extensive, diverse engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure domains
Demonstrated leadership in open-source project ownership (GISCollective) and community teaching (workshops, talks)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing, trunk-based development)
concerns: C++ experience limited to ~6 months at National Instruments plus a student project, far short of the 8-year requirement
No demonstrated experience with large-scale cloud compute platforms, distributed systems at scale, or hardware/storage architecture
No clear track record of formal technical leadership or mentoring specifically for cloud/DevOps engineering teams

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform/distributed systems leadership experience
Broad engineering versatility and craftsmanship mindset
